items.title: Why reviewing AI-generated code is devilishly hard
items.raw_excerpt: Hereâs the thing: when working on code with GenAI assistance (from a chat-bot, through IDE auto-completion, or, increasingly, with an AI agent) you need a better understanding of the system than when working without. Cognitive psychology and the workings of large language models (LLMs) give us four clues on why this happens.

title_i18n.en: Why reviewing AI-generated code is devilishly hard
title_i18n.zh: 审查AI生成的代码为何极其困难
title_i18n.es: Por qué revisar código generado por IA es endiabladamente difícil

excerpt_i18n.en: Hereâs the thing: when working on code with GenAI assistance (from a chat-bot, through IDE auto-completion, or, increasingly, with an AI agent) you need a better understanding of the system than when working without. Cognitive psychology and the workings of large language models (LLMs) give us four clues on why this happens.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 关键在于：在使用生成式AI辅助编写代码时（无论是通过聊天机器人、IDE自动补全，还是日益普及的AI智能体），你需要比不借助AI时更深入地理解系统。
excerpt_i18n.es: La cuestión es la siguiente: cuando trabajas con código asistido por IA generativa (mediante un chatbot, a través de la autocompletación del IDE o, cada vez más, con un agente de IA), necesitas un mejor conocimiento del sistema que cuando trabajas sin ella.
